[NDBG.14.20.1] Chooses which DS stream events ([NDBG.15]) the adapter
sends from now on, replacing the choice the `events` launch argument made
([NDBG.9.3.1]).

Request: `{ "kinds": ["factAsserted", "callMade"] }` — each the event's name
without `ds/`. An empty list sends none. An unknown name → DAP error naming
it.
